description: Meet T-Notes! One of the apps in the TRC-X suite of apps! Make simple notes, pin whats important, and even doodle some notes if you have a pen/stylus. You can even sync notes across your Windows computer and Windows Phone with T-Cloud (temporarily unavailable) The app is very customizable, with 10 different backgrounds and 2 animated background effects (rain and byte), you can make it look however you want!
